verdicts.justification: conf.py:331 'scipy': 'https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/'. Live curl: https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference//_static/documentation_options.js -> 404; corrected https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/_static/documentation_options.js -> 200 (returned DOCUMENTATION_OPTIONS for scipy 1.18.0). So sphinx-gallery cannot fetch scipy's inventory options and scipy cross-links are dropped.

Note: plain pickle.dumps(conf.sphinx_gallery_conf) actually SUCCEEDS (plotly_sg_scraper pickles by reference), but sphinx's cache check is type-based: with sphinx 9.1.0, sphinx.config.is_serializable(conf.sphinx_gallery_conf) returned False (dict contains a function), which is exactly the condition that emits "cannot cache unpickleable configuration value: 'sphinx_gallery_conf'... (because it contains a function, class, or module object)". Claim's warning is real; harmless-but-noisy, minor is right.
